overview.text: In a candidate forum, she said she supports incentives for developers to build multi-family housing and cutting red tape, but opposes subsidizing preschool. She called for ADA-compliant sidewalks and addressing homelessness, and said combating burglaries is a priority. She proposed reallocating budget funds to clean parks and safe streets. In another forum, she said she would undo the Fountain Avenue streetscape plan and keep the San Vicente plaza project paused.
